verdict.rationale: Blink lets you save hosts that can be reached by hostname alone (docs-11) and set up SSH keys for password-less access (docs-12), so saved hosts work without re-entering credentials. A community user also mentions maintaining host lists (comm-9). However, the documented connection flow is typing `ssh`/`mosh [user@]hostname` at the prompt (docs-15, docs-14), not a one-tap launcher. Missing for 10: evidence of a one-tap/tap-to-connect UI for saved hosts, documentation of saved password or credential storage for saved hosts, independent hands-on corroboration of the saved-host flow.
